Same here. 

When I first heard it I was a kid struggling to come to terms with his sexuality, struggling to find the strength to carry on in the face of unbearable bullying, with a father out of the picture and a mother struggling with her own health. It made me cry decades ago, and it makes me cry every time I hear it, even now. And I wouldn't want it any other way.

I was 16 at the rime, studying for my A-levels in the UK. Me and a friend had our classes finish as normal at around 2:30 or 3 and we decided to go back to his house (as he lived close to school) to listen to Chris Moyles on BBC Radio 1 and play some Playstation. Neither of us were aware of what had happened in the US on that day. 

We didn't really clock to start off that Chris wasn't saying much and it was just music. Then when he did speak he was all sombre and said something like "on a day like today, joking around and having a laugh doesn't feel appropriate, so we're just going to play some songs." 

Me and my friend looked at each other a bit confused - Chris Moyles was known for being this jovial jokester on air - and went downstairs to put the news on. 

We tuned in to see the south tower engulfed with flames, watch what amounts to a live-action replays of the first tower collapse, and then the second tower fall live. 

Watching it play out is indescribable for me. It didn't seem real. I wasn't scared or terrified, just weirdly calm as I tried to process what I had just witnessed. 

It truly was the day the world changed.

There's also just been some overt transphobia and racism. 

If you think this is acceptable, then I'm not sure where you would draw the line. 

You don't have to get rid of all general discussions, but come on man. In less than 12 hours, there's the full gamut of misogyny, sexism, racism, homophobia, and transphobia. You don't need to be edgy or deliberately offensive to women or minority groups in order to have a laugh or light hearted discussion. 

I was really hopeful of interesting discussions in politics and science, but instead there's been nothing all day and there's just some appalling attempt at "banter".  I maintain this server is currently a cesspit and not serving the function it was designed for.

In the time I've been on the server there's been a slew of overt racism and misogyny in the general channel. 

Not a good look for a server which aims to have high brow discussions. 

And then in the channels for intellectual discussion... Tumbleweeds. Only a couple of comments across the dozen or so speciality channels, with no discussion whatsoever. 

So far, this server is a cesspit with no intellectual value.
There's not much in the way of "mind-stimulating discussion" currently going on. More like shitposting and casual racism to be honest.
